### five-card-draw (resource)
five-card draw, discard and draw, classic poker

Classic draw poker: five cards each, face-down, then a betting round; each side may discard up to three cards (four when keeping an Ace) and draw replacements; one final betting round, then showdown. Standard rankings; tied hands split the pot.
